description: This header file declares functions related to the custom engine configuration in a automotive or engine control system. It includes function declarations for setting engine configurations, testing, and LCD control.

methods.name: setCustomEngineConfiguration
methods.description: Configures custom engine settings based on parameters provided.

methods.name: setFrankenso_01_LCD
methods.description: Initializes or updates the LCD display related to the Frankenso board setup.

methods.name: runSchedulingPrecisionTestIfNeeded
methods.description: Runs a test to check scheduling timing for engine control.

methods.name: setMinimalPinsEngineConfiguration
methods.description: Configures engine with minimal pin usage.

methods.name: setFrankensoBoardTestConfiguration
methods.description: Sets up test configuration for the Frankenso board.
